author: teteumac
body:
Consolidate the inclusive corrected-jet pT histograms `Pt_1`, `Pt_2` and `Pt_3` into `Pt_extended`: 140 uniform bins from 0 to 7000 GeV (50 GeV/bin). Reuse the former `Pt_3` booking and filling locations, with one `correctedJet.pt()` fill under the same inclusive selections and in the same folders.

Set the title to "Inclusive corrected jet p_{T}  extended range", the X axis to "Corrected jet p_{T} [GeV]" and the Y axis to "Jets / 50 GeV". Update the Calo-jet pT lookup in `DataCertificationJetMET` to use the new histogram. The repository search found no other consumers; similarly named HLT axis labels are unrelated.
title: [DQM] Consolidate inclusive jet DQM pT histograms
